1. Read :- Notice No. HCG-05/2026, dated 02/11/2026.
2. Read :- Notice No. HCG-01/2026, dated 04/11/2026.
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 04/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
In modification of the Notice mentioned in the
Preamble, It is hereby notified that ;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice P.M.Raval would not be available
on 05.11.2026 and 06.11.2026.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta
K. Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice D.N.Ray) would take
up the matters notified in the Cause list of Hon’ble
Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen
and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai.)
(3) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Maulik J.
Shelat) would take up the matters notified in the
Cause List of Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr.
Justice D.N.Ray.)
By Order of Hon’ble Acting The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
